name: CoreHealth
summary: CoreHealth is a white-label wellness platform with a library of challenges, 1:1 and group coaching, health assessments and self-paced content, and a dashboard for participation metrics. The vendor publishes no price, and its page offers only demo bookings.

facts.text: Per the page, the buyer can choose from a library of customizable challenges, covering physical, nutritional, financial and other themes, in individual, buddy or team formats.
Vendor page: the platform supports 1:1 or group coaching by chat, video or email, and health assessments are available in multiple languages and can be customized.
CoreHealth's page says self-paced programs are available that build mindfulness, resilience and mental health, and that content can be created and edited by the buyer.
Per the vendor's page, the dashboard lets the buyer manage participants and monitor program performance, and the page describes its scope as covering participation metrics.
No price is shown on the page. Its calls to action are Request A Demo and Book A Demo.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: The vendor publishes no price. Pricing is available on request only.

hiddenCosts: The vendor publishes no price, so no amount is recorded. The page does not say whether individual participant names appear in reports.
